payload.name: description
payload.value:
## Trigger
When a prompt is drawn in a repository with a Git clean filter, I want prompt rendering to avoid per-line diff metrics so that terminal startup stays responsive and does not trigger filter pipe failures.

## Steps to Reproduce
Enable git_metrics and render a prompt in a repository with a content clean filter. The installed prompt runs the filter while computing added and deleted line counts. A prior timeout-only correction left this work enabled.

## Scope
- `terminal_setup/templates/starship.toml`
- `.scripts/check_starship_prompt_filters.py`

## Evidence
A synthetic filtered repository measured approximately 261 ms with metrics and 16 ms without. Filter invocations changed from one to zero; branch and modified indicators remained visible. The reported filter traceback is a separate uncaught BrokenPipeError; no filter or hook will be disabled here.
